title: Terraria: Design Works - Preorder yours today!
author: Loki ISP
contents:
[h1][b]TERRARIA: DESIGN WORKS[/b][/h1]

[url=https://lostincult.co.uk/terraria][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/a976cf93cd75c042c57fa321a461b61cb024aa44.jpg[/img][/url]

This premium book will chart the design and development of Terraria from its inception back in 2011 through to today, written by Christian Donlan.

Now you can dig into the game’s development itself with Terraria: Design Works. Based on in-depth interviews with Andrew Spinks, the singular individual who created Terraria, along with the fascinating team who have worked with him to keep the game thriving for the last fifteen years, this is the story of a game developed with passion, ingenuity, imagination and generosity.

It’s easy to lose yourself in Terraria when playing, and now you’ll discover the challenges of charting a development course through such a rich, sprawling, and surprising game. You’ll meet the people who have worked with Spinks to evolve his original design, and you’ll come to understand where many of Terraria’s legendary elements come from, whether that’s a biome, an end-game monster or just a really cool sword!

Packed with behind the scene insights, developer interviews and never seen before content, the book is available standalone or as part of a Deluxe Edition complete with a treasure trove of Terraria goodies.

Dig deeper into the world of Terraria with our Deluxe edition of Terraria: Design Works!

Alongside the luxurious slipcase, you’ll discover a treasure trove of collectible items to unearth, all housed in a premium deluxe presentation box, perfect for keeping your treasures safe from prying eyes (or eye, for that matter…)

[list]
[*] [b]Bestiary Blitz card game[/b]: this quick play card game is designed around the enemies and bosses found in the world of Terraria! Each card in Bestiary Blitz features a Terraria enemy or boss, a bestiary entry description, and includes key performance categories with assigned values. Compare statistics of Terraria monsters to determine a winner for each round, with the ultimate goal of collecting all the cards from your opponents!
[*] [b]A bespoke papercraft kit[/b]: bring your very own piece of Terraria to life step by step when you assemble this paper theatre, featuring brand new pixel art - perfect for adorning the shelf of any fan.
[*] [b]A set of five pixel art pin badges[/b]: featuring the Magic Mirror, Rod of Discord, Angel statue, Terrarian Yoyo & Slime staff.
[*] [b]A pixel art poster[/b]: filled with words of wisdom from some of your favourite NPC’s, this sprite poster, printed onto rainbow effect holographic paper, is perfect for hanging on your wall.
[*] [b]A holo bookmark[/b]: the double sided bookmark is decorated with pixel sprites of some of Terraria’s most beloved furry friends, printed on rainbow effect holographic paper to match the pixel art poster!
[*] [b]Nine postcards[/b]: featuring some of Terraria’s most beloved biomes, these postcards are the perfect artifact for true fans, allowing you to take one step closer to its rich worlds.
[/list]
